SPIRITIST SKILLS

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000235]{Spiritual Magic} 【Max SL 10】

Each level learns one Spiritist spell. Offensive spells use (INS + WLP) for the Magic Check.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000236]{Healing Power} 【Max SL 2】

Spells targeting allies, with an arcane weapon equipped: each of those allies also recovers (3 + SL × your number of Bonds) HP.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000237]{Support Magic} 【Max SL 1】

Spells targeting allies, with an arcane weapon equipped: one targeted ally you have a Bond towards gains a bonus on their next Check this scene equal to that Bond's strength.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000238]{Vismagus} 【Max SL 1】

Short on MP, pay (10 + the spell's total MP cost) in HP instead — but the spell then recovers no HP for you.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000239]{Surge of Emotion} 【Max SL 3】

Invoking a Bond triggers one of its emotions' effects — not optional. Admiration seeds opportunities; inferiority hands out fumble triggers; Loyalty no longer costs the supporter their turn; each emotion has its own clause.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000240]{Body of Aether} 【Max SL 4】

Rituals cost (SL × 4) less MP, and shortfalls may be paid in HP — even to 0, at the price of Sacrificing yourself.
